name: DevOps & Platform Engineer
title: DevOps & Platform Engineer
description: Master enterprise cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), GitOps, and site reliability engineering. Linux internals, Docker, Kubernetes clusters, Helm, Terraform, GitOps with ArgoCD, CI/CD automation, and full-stack observability.

levels.title: Level 0 — Linux Internals, Networking & Shell Automation
levels.description: Linux process models, memory, cgroups, namespaces, systemd, TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS, and Bash scripting.

subjects.title: Linux Systems & Networking
subjects.description: Core subject domain covering Linux Systems & Networking.

topics.title: Linux Kernel Mechanics, cgroups & Networking Diagnostics
topics.description: Master operating system internals and network troubleshooting tools (tcpdump, ss, curl, dig).
learningObjectives: Understand internal architecture and core mechanics of Linux Kernel Mechanics, cgroups & Networking Diagnostics
Implement production-grade components using industry best practices for Linux Kernel Mechanics, cgroups & Networking Diagnostics
Diagnose runtime errors, misconfigurations, and edge cases in Linux Kernel Mechanics, cgroups & Networking Diagnostics
Explain design trade-offs and answer senior technical interview questions on Linux Kernel Mechanics, cgroups & Networking Diagnostics

learningItems.title: Linux Namespaces, Control Groups (cgroups v2) & Container Foundations
Process Management, Signals (SIGTERM/SIGKILL), systemd Service Units
Networking Foundations: TCP 3-Way Handshake, DNS Resolution, TLS Handshake, IPTables/NFTables
Robust Shell Scripting: Error Handling (set -euo pipefail), Arguments, Traps

practice.title: Hands-on Lab: Linux Kernel Mechanics, cgroups & Networking Diagnostics
practice.description: Implement, test, and validate core patterns of Linux Kernel Mechanics, cgroups & Networking Diagnostics in a realistic workspace environment.

practice.title: Independent Challenge: Linux Kernel Mechanics, cgroups & Networking Diagnostics
practice.description: Build end-to-end functionality for Linux Kernel Mechanics, cgroups & Networking Diagnostics from scratch and verify production error handling.

debugging.title: Diagnose & Resolve Production Issue in Linux Kernel Mechanics, cgroups & Networking Diagnostics
debugging.description: Troubleshoot a scenario where Linux Kernel Mechanics, cgroups & Networking Diagnostics throws unexpected exceptions or fails under high load / invalid payload.

assessments.question: Explain the fundamental architecture and best practices for Linux Kernel Mechanics, cgroups & Networking Diagnostics. What are common architectural pitfalls?
How do you diagnose and fix performance bottlenecks or security vulnerabilities when working with Linux Kernel Mechanics, cgroups & Networking Diagnostics?
